## Sorted keys for JSONStorage (2026-11-02)

The owner asked for JSONStorage to write its keys sorted by default. Their committed db.json fixtures in a service repo were producing noisy diffs whenever key order changed. They also said sorting should stay optional, so it needs an opt-out.

Memory holds only this opening ask. It has no observations, so no implementation, PR, release or rework is recorded. The request is at the exploring or planning stage, at about 10%. It is in progress and has not stalled.

What this shows so far: the owner wants defaults that cut review noise, and they want a way to turn them off. Any work on this should keep both parts. Sorted output should be the default, and an option should switch it off. There is too little history to say anything about turnaround or rework.

preferences.preference: Wants sensible defaults that reduce noise, but with an opt-out to preserve flexibility.
